name: Abfaltersbach
kurzbeschreibung: Charming village in the **Pustertal** with traditional **Osttiroler** farmhouses and stunning mountain views.
beschreibung:
Abfaltersbach lies at 983 m altitude in the sunny Pustertal in Osttirol, nestled between the Lienzer Dolomiten to the north and the Karnischen Alpen to the south. The village belongs to the district of Lienz and has about 650 residents, spread across traditional farms and well‑kept houses. Its position on the valley floor brings mild temperatures and many hours of sunshine – a circumstance that is not a given at this height.

The surroundings invite hikes that are also suitable for families. A popular route is the ascent to the Thurntaler Alm, which offers a wide view over the entire Pustertal up to the Lienzer Dolomiten. Via the Pustertaler Höhenweg experienced hikers can reach the neighboring valleys such as Defereggen or Villgratental. In winter the village lift at the Thurntaler provides ski fun for beginners and families. What makes Abfaltersbach special is the tranquility: there is no through traffic, no lift bustle – only the babbling of the nearby stream and, in the evening, the view of the illuminated mountain ranges.

Culinary highlights feature Osttiroler classics on the table: Schlickkrapfen, Kasnocken and the regional Ziegenkäse from the surrounding mountain farms. The village’s sense of community is evident at the traditional summer Dorffest, when the brass band starts playing and the farmers open their farms. 🏘️
